svg.title: ProofBerry One-Role Review Scope
svg.desc: A buyer-facing scope card describing what a bounded ProofBerry staffing design-partner review includes and does not claim.
svg.text: PROOFBERRY AI · BUYER VALIDATION CARD
Validate the scope
before the call.
One bounded role. Buyer-defined evaluation. Human-owned hiring decisions.
THE ONE-ROLE REVIEW CAN COVER
• One live requisition and one accountable pilot owner
• A finite decision window and buyer-defined role #2 success rule
• An optional comparison baseline for interpreting the test
• A reviewable evidence-packet structure for the role
• Clear human ownership of consequential hiring decisions
THIS CARD DOES NOT PROMISE
• A candidate score, hiring recommendation, or automatic decision
• Identity, fraud, background, or compliance certification
• Predictive validity, placement lift, ROI, or baseline outperformance
• ATS integration, production deployment, or a response-time SLA
Buyer-controlled next step
Review the scope. Carry the pilot brief internally. Then request the
one-role conversation only if the bounded test fits your buying need.
Contact information is not shared by viewing this card.
PROOFBERRY AI
Design-partner scope card · buyer-side pilot fit only · not a hiring outcome claim
